keyVerseDR: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased." (Mt 3:17)

level1.title: Jesus Is Baptized
level1.story: Jesus was baptized in the Jordan River. The Holy Spirit came down like a dove. God said, "This is My beloved Son!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What came down like a dove?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for my baptism. Amen.

activity.title: My baptism candle
activity.intro: At Baptism we receive the light of Christ. Color the flame.

level2.title: Beloved Son
level2.story: Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River to be baptized by John. John said, "I need to be baptized by You!" Jesus answered that it was right to do what God asks. When Jesus came up from the water, the heavens opened, and the Spirit of God came down like a dove. A voice from heaven said, "This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."
level2.keyLine: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How do we see the Trinity in this story?
How does your baptism make you God's child?
actions: Make the Sign of the Cross carefully
level2.prayer: Father, thank You for making me Your child. Amen.

activity.title: Signs of Baptism
activity.intro: Match each sign to what it means.

art.mainBrief: Jesus in the Jordan, John pours water, dove above, light from cloud
art.heartBrief: Shell and water drops; dove on top of heart
